workerId.description: Worker id the lease / claim event names.

state.description: Derived: `busy` (live lease, fresh heartbeat), `offline` (lease held but stale — reaper candidate), `idle` (recent claim, no live lease).

projectId.description: Owning project (via the leased item's run); null for idle rows with no live lease.

profileKey.description: Profile of the leased item; null when idle.

image.description: Image of the leased item; null when idle.

currentWorkItemId.description: Item the worker holds; null when idle.

currentRunId.description: Run of the leased item; null when idle.

leaseUntil.description: Lease expiry of the held item; null when idle.

heartbeatAt.description: Last heartbeat on the held item; null when idle.

attempt.description: Attempts of the held item; 0 when idle.

lastSeenAt.description: Most recent of the worker's claim events, or the held item's heartbeat — whichever is later.

description: Wire row of one worker as the dashboard queue page sees it. Workers are derived, not registered: a busy worker is a live work-item lease (`leased_by` on a `Running` row); an idle worker is one whose last claim still shows in the recent journal window. Fields only a container runtime could answer (provider handle, uptime) are absent on purpose — this host does not compose the compute engine.
